note.windows: The first build takes 30 to 60 minutes and about 6 GB. Python, CMake, Ninja and the Visual Studio Build Tools (about 3 GB) are installed if they are missing; Windows asks for permission once.
note.darwin: On a Mac this builds the Windows game and plays it under CrossOver, with Tiberian Sun installed in a CrossOver bottle: pick its folder there. It needs Homebrew, and installs the rest with it. Building downloads Microsoft's C runtime and Windows SDK under Microsoft's licence (go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=2086102); pressing Build accepts it. The first build takes 30 to 60 minutes and about 7 GB.
note.default: The first build takes 30 to 60 minutes and about 6 GB. It needs 32-bit gcc and SDL2 from your package manager; if any are missing it says which, with the command to install them.
